mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS (as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns) is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window in historical data.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market repricing.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous labor market weakness (UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS growth < 0.1%) combined with strong housing demand (HOUST > 1400) creates economic uncertainty that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the UNRATE * PAYEMS interaction term is greater than -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window when HOUST > 1400.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 20000 billion and CPIAUCSL > 300.0), high inflation pressures trigger aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with GDPC1 > 20000 and CPIAUCSL > 300.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS (as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns) is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window in historical data.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) combined with weak industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates restrictive monetary policy during supply contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the FEDFUNDS * INDPRO interaction term is greater than -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300.0), aggressive policy actions lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: In periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 300.0, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.
